insight: Built by Seoul-based Gaudio Lab on its GSEP model; topped MusicTech's 2025 ranking of stem-separation tools.
name: Gaudio Studio
tagline: AI stem separation that splits any song into vocals and instruments.
description: Web and mobile tool that separates a track into up to six stems — vocals, drums, bass, piano, guitar, and other instruments — using Gaudio Lab's GSEP source-separation model. Accepts wav, flac, m4a, and mp3 uploads or a YouTube URL, and is aimed at remixers, producers, and musicians who want clean isolated parts for practice or rework.
edge: Six-stem split (including separate piano and guitar) from a GSEP model that benchmarks at the top of recent separation comparisons.
pros: Up to six separate stems per track
Available on web, iOS, and Android
cons: Paid use is credit-based, not flat-rate

references.title: Gaudio Studio arrives on smartphones for stem extraction
